board_terminal_run.userDescription: Run Command on Board on the connected remote board
board_terminal_send.userDescription: Send Input to Board on the connected remote board
board_terminal_output.userDescription: Read Board Terminal Output on the connected remote board
board_terminal_kill.userDescription: Close Board Terminal on the connected remote board
board_file_upload.userDescription: Upload a local file or directory to the connected board
board_file_download.userDescription: Download a board file or directory to the local computer
